name: Kouji
source:
A man with who [url=https://vndb.org/c74120]Ena[/url] had started the preliminaries at the beginning of the story. They were brutally interceded by [url=https://vndb.org/c76033]Souma[/url] and he fled because he didn't know she had a brother. 

[spoiler]Seems to be Ena's actual boyfriend (from his point of view) but Ena seems to see him more like a Sex Friend.[/spoiler]
